I couldn't set up the 07:45 daily brief. I don't have a scheduler in this conversation, so nothing will post automatically starting tomorrow (Thu 15 Oct). Someone with access to scheduled jobs will need to add it. Or I can post a one-off brief whenever you ask.

I replied in the thread on your message in #strategic-random with two notes for when it's set up:
- **Visibility:** Everyone in #strategic-random (Gideon, Nadia, you) is already in #strategic-pod and #inc-vtg-hartford, so a brief posted there won't expose those channels to anyone new.
- **Finance:** The brief will leave out money terms. June and Anselm aren't in this channel, so any figure would need their approval first. It will note that figures were discussed and point to the source channel.
